mostWorthwhile.text: Making Memory and using it to create a learned path was most worthwhile: the returning fruit made it clear how an earlier experience could guide behaviour beyond what the animal could currently see.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting Learned path after it completed its goal yielded no partners; it was a mildly repetitive dead end.

surprise.text: Call initially had no available partner, but Memory later connected with it to make a learned alarm. That changed my understanding of how the warning would work.

arbitrary.text: Fear combined with Air to make a call felt like a mythic shortcut, though the result explained the signal's purpose. The initial fruit attempt was also unclear: it seemed relevant to the stated memory goal but had no available operation then.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how learned signals and social life develop, especially after the ending noted that cooperation can coexist with conflict.
